## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible issue and what this change does. Link the related issue when one exists.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks you ran, their results, and any checks you could not run.

## Accessibility rule evidence

For rule changes, include the primary specification reference, a failing example, a passing example and known limitations. Mark this section as not applicable for other changes.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing architecture and English-language conventions.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant regression or false-positive cases.
- [ ] Rule documentation was regenerated when metadata changed.
- [ ] README and compatibility notes match the implemented behavior.
